questions.question: The LORD called the mountains to hear His case against the nations. True or false?
When the LORD asked His people what He had done to them, what did He tell them to testify about?

answers.text: How they have kept His laws
Who they trust more than Him

questions.question: The LORD reminded Israel that He brought them out of Egypt. Which leaders did He say He sent before them?
After showing people what is good, what does the LORD say He requires of them?

answers.text: Justice and mercy and a humble walk with Him
More and bigger offerings at every feast
A long trip up to the temple every year
